scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER FREE SPINS
 At the beginning of the PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER FREE SPINS ROUND,
 the player is awarded 12 free spins with a starting multiplier of 1x.
 After every free spin, the multiplier increases by 1x.
 The wins of each free spin are multiplied by the current multiplier, except for SCATTER wins.
 3 SCATTER symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 during the PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER FREE SPINS ROUND
 award 12 additional free spins, up to a total of 60 free spins.
 The feature can be retriggered up to 4 times.
 Special reels are in play during the PROGRESSIVE MULTIPLIER
 FREE SPINS ROUND.
